Important notice

This is a quick self-check tool for travellers, not an authoritative meteorological or aviation source. Red/orange/yellow/green levels are inferred from public numerical forecasts using fixed thresholds. For actual delays, cancellations or road closures, always defer to same-day notices from national weather agencies, airports and your airline.

Data sources & methodology

Weather: Open-Meteo public forecast API (non-commercial, CC BY 4.0). Rain radar: RainViewer public tiles. Cyclone/flood events: GDACS (EC JRC / UN) official alert levels. River discharge: Open-Meteo Flood API / Copernicus GloFAS v4 model. Geocoding: local parsing of Google Maps links + Open-Meteo Geocoder / OSM Nominatim. Road closures & official controls: direct links to national authority notices (no unified free API). For flight status, check official airport or airline information. In 24-hour summaries, thunderstorm or visibility ≤1 km alone counts as Warning only with ≥2 hours in one city or occurrences in ≥2 cities; a single city-hour counts as Watch, while hourly query levels stay unchanged. Attractions: Wikidata (CC0), © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL); images from Wikimedia Commons, licences in each photo credit. Icons: Phosphor (MIT), Tabler (MIT)

Weather data is public; My Trips requires Google sign-in · Auto-updated daily at 01:00 (GMT+7)
